description: This file contains tests for the litellm library, specifically testing function calling behavior with non-OpenAI models. It includes a test case that verifies the library's handling of function prompts when the model does not support function calling.

methods.name: test_function_call_non_openai_model()
methods.description: Tests the behavior of litellm.completion when using a non-OpenAI model without setting set_function_to_prompt.
